system.notes:
Huge veridian water demon that has a fish-man upper torso, two arms ending in a plethora of tentacles, and a sleek, eel-like body. Followers are boggards, sahuagin, and desperate coast folk.

AC 18, HP 91, ATK 2 bite (near) +10 (4d6 + swallow) and 2 claws (near) +10 (2d6) or 1 black breath, MV far (swim), S +6, D +3, C +6, I +5, W +5, Ch +6, AL C, LV 19

Aquatic Mastery. Aquatic creatures hearing Dagon, CHA 18+ or utterly charmed for 1d8 days.

Black Breath. A double near- size murky cloud extending from Dagon, all non-demons WIS 18+ or blind 1d4 rounds.

Pure Evil. Only damaged by silver weapons or magic sources. Immune to acid and fire. Cannot be held or restrained.

Swallow. On a natural attack roll of 18-20, target is swallowed. Total darkness inside, 1d4 permanent WIS loss each round, transformed into shadow demon at 0 WIS. Dagon regurgitates all swallowed if dealt at least 20 damage in one round to the inside of its gullet.
